input.cover_letter:
Hello Orbit Retail team,

I am a Python backend developer with 3.5 years of commercial experience, and your Python Django Developer role closely matches my current work. At Greenfield Retail (remote, since April 2023) I build and maintain the orders and catalogue APIs for an e-commerce platform using Django, Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL, which is very close to the catalogue and checkout APIs you describe.

Some results relevant to your requirements:
- Cut the p95 latency of the orders API from 800 ms to 320 ms with Redis caching and query optimisation.
- Moved a nightly reporting job to Celery workers, reducing run time from 50 to 15 minutes.
- Raised test coverage from 55% to 82% with pytest and factory_boy.
- Automated deployments with GitHub Actions and Docker, cutting a release from 40 to 10 minutes.
- Reviewed pull requests for two junior developers.

I am looking to grow into larger systems, with more ownership of whole services and more complex architecture. I work remotely, my English is B2, and my notice period is two weeks. I would be glad to discuss how I can contribute to your marketplace.

Best regards,
Olena Shevchenko

structured.final_answer:
I submitted 2 applications to remote Python/Django jobs:
- J-103, Middle Django Developer at Brightside Commerce: application APP-0002. It uses Django, DRF, Celery and Redis on an e-commerce platform, which matches your experience. The company is also splitting a Django monolith into services, which fits your wish to grow.
- J-101, Python Backend Developer at Lumen Labs: application APP-0003. It is a remote role where you would own the booking API, and it needs Django, DRF and PostgreSQL. The form asked why you are looking and for one achievement. I answered both from your profile and CV (your growth goals, and the latency and Celery results).

J-108 at Orbit Retail was my first pick, but you had already applied on 2026-10-01 (APP-0001). I did not send a duplicate and replaced it with J-101.

Your salary expectation is $3,200 a month. J-103 pays $2,800–3,800 and J-101 pays $3,000–4,200, so the J-103 range starts below that figure. I did not check the other open roles in detail. J-112 (Helio Finance) asks for 3+ years and pays $3,300–4,500, so it would be a reasonable next option.

You don't need to do anything now.
